mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 97.0) signals a deepening economic contraction that triggers amplified negative equity market reactions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both UNRATE > 9.0 and INDPRO < 97.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the early recovery phase, rising housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal improving consumer demand fundamentals, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances during the early recovery phase, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO is declining (e.g., month-over-month change < 0), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales below 330,000 million dollars (RSAFS < 330000) signals weak consumer spending that depresses corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when RSAFS < 330000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals a liquidity trap with limited policy options, triggering amplified negative equity market reactions that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 and UNRATE > 9.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced corporate output capacity that depresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances during manufacturing contraction, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
